verdict.rationale: The docs show consents split by product type: separate authorisation endpoints for account-information access (embedded account authorisation, re-authorise account consent) and for payments (bulk payment authorisation). Data calls are tied to the presented consent token. This suggests consents are scoped to AIS vs PIS rather than one blanket grant, but nothing documents finer permission or scope selection within data access. Missing for 10: documented per-scope or permission selection (e.g., balances-only vs transactions), explicit data-minimization controls or guidance, consent duration/field limits, and independent corroboration.
